## Where I'm deliberately not complying with the template

The protocol demands, per finding, a numeric `CORROBORATION` residual-risk equation (`R_k = R_old × (1 − η·d·p) × S_k + ν_eff` with specific η, d, p, S_k, ν_eff) and a `NOVELTY` block with arXiv citations. For a one-line dead-import cleanup those numbers would be invented — I have no measured basis for η=0.8 vs 0.6, and I ran no external search, so the honest values are `c_ext = 0` and no citations. Manufacturing them, or manufacturing a fresh batch of F00x findings to fill the round, is precisely the "eagerness to please" / findings-for-their-own-sake failure mode the CDSFL directives (`no-fabricated-certainty`, `p-pass-anti-nitpick`) exist to prevent. So I'm giving you the one real finding at its true (low) severity and a straight depletion verdict instead.

**Verdicts on open/confirmed entries:** no CHALLENGE. C0019, C0020, C0026, C0027, C0041, C0045 all describe real defects and I found no error in them. C0044 (Codex withdrawal) is correctly parked.

If what you actually want is for me to drive the real panel harness (`composer.py`) and have CC2/CX/GE/CGPT/DS score this round for real, say so and I'll dispatch it — that produces genuine independent verdicts rather than me role-playing five models.
